Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subhash Chand
------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Jitesh Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shailesh Kumar Sinha, A.P.P.
--------
05/14.08.2024
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2.  This bail application has been filed on behalf of the abovenamed petitioner with prayer to release on bail in connection with Thakurgangti P.S. Case No.03 of 2024 registered under Sections 354-D,
376(2)(n), 501, 504, 506 & 509 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 66(E) and 67(A) of the I.T.
Act pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Godda.

3. As per allegations made in the F.I.R., the victim came in contact of petitioner--Hitesh Kumar Singh in the year 2022 and the intimacy between the two grew up by way of Instagram and Whatsapp as well.
Thereafter both began to love each other and the accused had allured her to marry with her.
It is further alleged that on the pretext of marriage, the accused also established physical relation with her and also clicked her nude photograph and prepared her video.
It is also alleged that the accused had refused to marry with her and on the basis of the nude video he continued to blackmail her and sexually exploited her.

4. As per allegations made in the F.I.R., the victim was major (20 years old) and the conduct of the victim is thoroughly found consensual.
5.

In view of the submissions made and materials on record, the bail application of the petitioner is,
hereby, allowed.
Let the petitioner be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Hitesh Kumar Singh S/O Kishor Singh Aged ... vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... Opp
